verdict.rationale: Several evidence items (riveter-docs-26, -27, -30, -31) are spec content sourced directly from https://docs.riveterhq.com/openapi.yaml, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is published at a downloadable URL. The probe's 404s covered only .json and swagger paths, not the .yaml file, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: docs that point users to the spec download, a JSON variant (the probed JSON paths 404), and independent corroboration of the spec's completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The Riveter API lets you enrich data, build datasets, scrape webpages, quickly search the web, and extract data from complicated websites programmatically.
up to 10,000 rows per `/enrich` request with `enrichment_id`
